name: Team Bulbasaur: Zephyr Grounding & Solar Overgrowth
archetype: Sleep control, Intimidate attack reduction, and psychic anti-air coverage.
gym_duel_rationale: Falkner's 5v5 aerial battle requires precise counter-measures against Lightning Rod traps and Air Balloons: Venusaur/Charizard levels to Cap 63 to match Falkner's ace, using Sleep Powder to immediately pacify Ursaring/Pidgeot and melting Skarmory/Houndoom with Flamethrower; Gyarados/Arbok enters to trigger Intimidate, dropping Ursaring/Pidgeot's physical Attack while popping Skarmory/Houndoom's Air Balloon with Aqua Tail; Alakazam/Weezing cleanly dismantles Granbull/Combusken and Marowak/Dustox with STAB Psychic; Kingler/Primeape smashes Skarmory/Houndoom with super-effective Close Combat; and Snorlax sponges special hits with Rest and Leftovers.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 63. STAB Flamethrower burns down Skarmory/Houndoom. Sleep Powder immediately shuts down Falkner's fast Ursaring/Pidgeot ace.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts Ursaring/Pidgeot's 96 Attack on switch-in. Aqua Tail pops Skarmory/Houndoom's Air Balloon and washes away Marowak/Dustox.
495 BST special sweeper with 118 SpA. STAB Psychic effortlessly destroys Granbull/Combusken and Marowak/Dustox while Levitate provides Bone Rush immunity.
500 BST physical titan. Close Combat exploits Skarmory/Houndoom's Fighting weakness, while Crabhammer washes away Marowak/Dustox.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Flying and Fire moves effortlessly, sustaining infinitely across long duels with Rest and Sleep Talk.
High-Speed Flying scout. Immune to Ground moves and provides team-wide Tailwind speed doubles during overworld cave and route traversal.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against bulky route trainers.
High-speed Electric coverage packing Discharge and Light Screen against opposing birds.
High Jump Kick physical breaker capable of substituting into the active party for Fighting STAB.
